row_id_basis: Derived citation identifier: source id, trustee account id, PDF page and pdftotext line; not an original transaction id.
scope: Every published transaction of Glantz Exhibit B-2 account 1ZA192, 1992-12-07 through 2008-10-30. Trustee computations in a complaint, not a complete BLMIS general ledger or independently established net equity. Transfer principal is copied from the trustee's columns 6 and 7 as named oracle inputs; the statement amount in column 3 is retained separately. Cash, transfer counterpart and investor-capital accounts are an explicit analysis-book construction, not source-published double-entry accounts.
